## Changes

[Japanese template](pull_request_template.ja.md)

Provider and document format / UNCONFIRMED ID:

## Evidence and verification

- Format/specification sources:
- Fictional fixtures and independently derived expected results:
- Unit tests / build / headless Chrome E2E / workflow verification:
- Coverage (lines, branches, functions) and confirmation that new modules appear:
- Unsupported or unverified behavior:

Do not attach personal documents, real transaction values, account numbers, wallet addresses, or secrets.

## Required fixture checks

- [ ] No real data is included in fixtures, attachments, screenshots, saved records, or backups.
- [ ] Names, accounts, quantities, amounts, dates, addresses, and IDs are independently fictional; changing names alone is not sufficient.
- [ ] Stock fixtures use FICT / OTHER rather than a real holding's ticker.

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING and included tests with any provider addition.
- [ ] The latest revision passes CI, including all coverage thresholds; threshold/exclusion changes are explicitly explained.
